subject: Piece of Heart
text: Behind the waterfall in Zora's River, a ladder leads from the water to a hidden alcove containing a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote: If you look behind it, you'll see a ladder extending from the water. Use the Cucco you used to get down here in the first place to get to this ladder. Climb the ladder and you'll find a hidden alcove with another Piece of Heart inside.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: At night, a Gold Skulltula is located on the wall of the Laboratory at Lake Hylia.

evidence.quote: Once you do, head to shore, make sure it's night, and you'll see yet another Gold Skulltula on the wall of the Laboratory.

subject: Mask of Truth
text: The Mask of Truth allows Link to read minds and speak with Gossip Stones.

evidence.quote: - Mask of Truth: Allows you to read people's minds, and you are also able to talk to Gossip Stones.

subject: Deku Nut Upgrade
text: Wearing the Mask of Truth in the Forest Stage allows Link to receive a Deku Nut Upgrade that increases carrying capacity to 40 Deku Nuts, but this upgrade cannot be obtained after pulling the Master Sword.

evidence.quote: Wear the Mask of Truth and find the leader and he'll give you a Deku Nut Upgrade. You can now carry 40 Deku Nuts...NOTE: You can NOT get this upgrade after pulling out the Master Sword for the first time.

subject: Master Sword
text: Pulling the Master Sword from its pedestal in the Temple of Time seals Link away in the Chamber of Sages for 7 years until he grows into a teen.

evidence.quote: Head through and you'll find the Master Sword on a pedestal. Go pull it out...Link pulled the Master Sword, his soul was sealed away in the Chamber of Sages for 7 years because he was not old enough to be the Hero of Time and to wield the Master Sword yet.

subject: Advanced Spin Slash
text: The Advanced Spin Slash is performed by holding B until the sword glows yellow, then releasing.

evidence.quote: Advanced Spin Slash (Hold B until the sword is yellow, then release)

subject: Adult Link
text: Adult Link can only use Deku Nuts, Ocarina of Time, Bombchus, Bombs, magic powers, and Bottles among items obtained as Young Link.

evidence.quote: The only items Adult Link can use are the Deku Nuts, Ocarina of Time, Bombchus, and Bombs. Of course, you can use Bottles and the magic powers with either Link.

subject: Epona
text: After paying 50 Rupees to race Ingo twice and winning both races, Link can jump the ranch boundary fences with Epona to keep her and ride her across Hyrule Field.

evidence.quote: talk to Ingo, and he'll ask if you want to race him for 50 Rupees...After beating him, he'll want you to race him again, and if you win you get to keep Epona...You see the fences acting as the ranch's boundary? Build up a lot of speed and you'll be able to jump clean over them. Now you're free to use Epona!

subject: Pocket Egg
text: The lady who owns the chicken pen in Kakariko Village gives Link a Pocket Egg that hatches overnight.

evidence.quote: In the town, head over to that lady who owns the chicken pen. She'll give you a Pocket Egg. This'll hatch over night.

subject: Song of Storms
text: Showing the Ocarina of Time to the man inside the Kakariko Village windmill teaches Link the Song of Storms.

evidence.quote: Show him the Ocarina of Time and he'll play the song that the young boy played. You now have learned the SONG OF STORMS!

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Riding the grown Magic Bean plant in the Graveyard brings Link to a ledge where breaking a crate reveals a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote: Get on the plant, and it'll take you to a ledge with a crate on it. Break the crate to reveal a Piece of Heart.

subject: Hookshot
text: Following Dampe's ghost through his grave race to the end awards Link the Hookshot.

evidence.quote: Down below is Dampe's grave...Once you reach the end, he'll give you the HOOKSHOT, a useful weapon and item that lets you stun enemies and cling onto wooden surfaces and drag you toward it.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Moving the Time blocks inside Dampe's grave leads to a high ledge inside the windmill where Link can reach a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote: Head through the opening here and you'll find some blocks with the same design as the Door of Time. Use the Song of Time to move these blocks. Head through and you'll be inside the windmill on a high ledge. Use one of the ledges on the machine to reach yet another Piece of Heart.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Finishing Dampe's grave race a second time in under 1 minute awards a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote: Race him again, but this time you have to finish in under one minute...If you finish under a minute, you'll get another Piece of Heart.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Hookshotting from the windmill fence onto the house with the gray roof in Kakariko Village allows Link to speak to a person on the roof for a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote: hop on the fence near the windmill here, equip the Hookshot (keep it equipped as you're gonna use it a lot), and use it to hook onto the house with the gray roof. On top of here is a person here. Talk to him and he'll give you another Piece of Heart for your trouble.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: At night, Link can Hookshot from the Skulltula House onto the roof of Impa's house to retrieve a Gold Skulltula token.

evidence.quote: Now, make it night and head to Impa's house. It's the southernmost house in the village. Before entering the door though, face the Skulltula House and Hookshot on top of it. From there, Hookshot on top of Impa's House. Up here is a Gold Skulltula. Use the Hookshot to retrieve the token.

subject: Cojiro
text: Waking Talon with the hatched Pocket Cucco and returning it to the Cucco lady rewards Link with the blue Cucco Cojiro.

evidence.quote: Use the Pocket Cucco that just hatched to wake him up and he'll get up and take back the ranch...Send the Pocket Cucco to the Cucco lady and she'll be so pleased that she'll give you a blue Cucco named Cojiro.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Riding the grown Magic Bean plant at the entrance of Dodongo's Cavern allows Link to jump to a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote: Right at the entrance of Dodongo's Cavern, the Magic Bean you planted there while you were young has grown now. Ride it to reach another Piece of Heart you can jump to.

subject: Huge Rupee
text: Playing the Song of Storms on the platform outside Goron City opens a Secret Cave with a treasure chest containing a Huge Rupee.

evidence.quote: On the platform in front of the entrance, play the Song of Storms to open a Secret Cave. Inside is a treasure chest with a Huge Rupee.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: In Goron City, a Gold Skulltula is located on the back of the suspended platform accessible via the ropes behind it.

evidence.quote: Now you see the platform in the middle suspended by ropes? Walk on one of the ropes behind it to see a Gold Skulltula on the back of that platform.

subject: Business Scrubs
text: Playing the Song of Storms near the rock circle at the start of Zora's River reveals a Secret Cave with Business Scrubs selling Green Potion and Red Potion for 40 Rupees each.

evidence.quote: At the start, play the Song of Storms near the circle of rocks where the Cucco is to reveal a Secret Cave. Inside are two Business Scrubs. One sells a Green Potion for 40 Rupees, another sells a Red Potion for the same price.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: At night, riding the grown Magic Bean plant to the high platform in Zora's River reveals a Gold Skulltula on the southern wall.

evidence.quote: Exit, and use the grown Magic Bean plant to get to the high platform with the two Secret Caves, making sure it's night. Up here, look around the southern wall to see another Gold Skulltula.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Past the wooden bridge in Zora's River, a Gold Skulltula hangs high on the wall and can be reached by Hookshot from the fence.

evidence.quote: Next, continue on in Zora's River, and past the wooden bridge, you'll see a Gold Skulltula high up on the wall. It may seem too far for your Hookshot, but hop onto the fence facing the Skulltula, and the Hookshot will be able to reach the enemy.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: In Zora's Fountain, jumping across the floating ice platforms leads Link to a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote: You'll notice here that Lord Jabu-Jabu is gone, and in its place is a bunch of ice platforms. You see the Piece of Heart in the distance? Jump across the ice carefully to reach it.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Riding the grown Magic Bean plant by the Laboratory in Lake Hylia and climbing the roof ladder yields a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote: Here, use the now grown Magic Bean by the Laboratory to get up on the roof. Be careful of the Guays, and climb up the ladder to get yet another Piece of Heart.

subject: Pierre the Scarecrow
text: Playing the custom song to the scarecrow at Lake Hylia makes his brother appear at specific locations across Hyrule to act as a Hookshot target.

evidence.quote: Now, head over to the scarecrow by the now-dry shore and play the song you played to it while as Young Link, and he'll remember the song...Now when you play this song at certain spots, the scarecrow's brother will pop up and you'll be able to Hookshot onto him to reach hidden areas.

subject: Gold Scale
text: Catching a fish of 15 lb. or greater at the Lake Hylia Fishing Hole rewards Link with the Gold Scale, which allows diving for 9 seconds.

evidence.quote: Inside, again play for 20 Rupees, and attempt to catch a 15 pound or more fish...If you're patient enough and get the 15 lb. or greater fish, then the Fishing Hole owner will give you the Gold Scale, which allows you to dive for a whopping 9 seconds.

subject: Bombchus
text: The prize obtained at the Skulltula House in Kakariko Village is a bunch of Bombchus.

evidence.quote: Head over to Kakariko Village and gain your next prize at the Skulltula House, which is a measly bunch of Bombchus.
